description: Spanish-language Venezuelan pop band Rawayana plays a 2026 world tour date at the Kia Forum in Inglewood (8pm).
Pop singer Mad Tsai performs at the Roxy Theatre on Sunset Strip in West Hollywood (8pm).
Touring production of the comedy musical Oh, Mary! at the Ahmanson Theatre in downtown LA (7pm).
Touring production of The Who's Tommy, the rock musical based on The Who's album, at the Hollywood Pantages Theatre (6:30pm).
Hip-hop night marking Lil Peep's 30th birthday, with the Lil Peep show at the Hollywood Palladium (7pm).
MARVIN, a stage musical about Marvin Gaye, at the Redondo Beach Performing Arts Center (7pm).
Repertory screening of Beetlejuice at the New Beverly Cinema in Fairfax (6:30pm).
Stage production of Dear Evan Hansen at the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts (6:30pm).
Daytime family party at The Compound in Commerce with live banda, DJs, pony rides, and a mechanical bull (1pm).
Hip-hop and pop artist Tul8te plays House of Blues Anaheim (7pm), a standing all-ages show.
Rock show with British punk band The Damned, plus Agent Orange and The Courettes, at The Observatory in Santa Ana (7pm).
Hip-hop show by 1 Umbrella at the Constellation Room in Santa Ana (7pm).
Filipino music concert headlined by Sharon Cuneta with Bugoy Drilon at Pechanga Resort Casino in Temecula (7:30pm).
